decisions.decision: Extend 035s natural-key-identity-roster.json in place, additive only (schema_version stays 1); 038 authors a proposal and never edits 035s file
decisions.why: Spec Assumptions forbid a second identity mechanism; 035 is in_progress so a schema bump would force it to touch its 3 existing entries mid-flight
decisions.rejected: A 038-local roster; a required per-entry consumers field with a schema_version 1->2 bump

decisions.decision: Census instrument = Lib/census.py + census_cli.py + tests/integration/test_object_census.py; NOT debug/ and NOT folded into tests/verification/fidelity_census.py
decisions.why: SC-009 forbids hand-written scripting; the test_* filename means the 037-locked pyproject.toml needs no edit; 024s instrument is field-level and offline by design
decisions.rejected: debug/audit_object_census.py; extending the 024 field-level census; extending harness reopen_and_count

decisions.decision: Closure switch-on is per-relationship behind a CLOSURE_EDGES_VERIFIED allowlist that lands empty, consumed in Lib/preview.py only
decisions.why: FR-018 requires each edge verified before it influences a plan, and all 24 *_dependencies() producers are unverified by construction; a single global flag cannot express per-edge verification
decisions.rejected: One global include_closure flag; consuming dependencies in transfer.execute (breaks Principle III)

decisions.decision: Enrichment widens _plan_gold_reserved_edit (categories.py:194) to owned collections as add-only UPDATE, rather than adding a parallel enrich path
decisions.why: Principle IV already defines SKIP by field-identity comparison, so G3 is a violation of existing rules; the write machinery already exists, only the decision is wrong
decisions.rejected: A new enrich_present() planner; reusing OVERWRITE (permits blanking, violates FR-021)

decisions.decision: Phase 4 splits: 4a wholly-owned rule graphs after Phase 1; 4b shared project-level contexts after Phase 2
decisions.why: Live probe found 6 of 18 rules reference PhSimpleContext* owned by PhPhonData.ContextsOS, making them a closure problem; creating them with an empty MembersRS would be a silent content loss
decisions.rejected: Treating Phase 4 as a local create depending only on Phase 1

decisions.decision: FsFeatStrucType is promoted from report-only to a Phase 1 prerequisite, satisfied by registering one closure edge (no new create code)
decisions.why: Probe refuted the no-create-path premise and showed 42 of 42 FsFeatStruc carry TypeRA into the feature system, so Phase 1s ~2083 restored MSAs would each hold an unsatisfiable reference, which Principle I forbids

decisions.decision: Land order 037 -> 038-affix-fidelity -> this feature -> re-census; claim categories.py for Phases 2/3 and transfer.py before any edit
decisions.why: transfer.py is a three-way hazard (modified on 037 +33 and 038-affix-fidelity +58); categories.py is the file every branch touches
decisions.rejected: Proceeding without lockout claims and resolving at merge
